correctness.rationale: For all integer s>=3, alpha>2, C=s^2-4>=5, and z=alpha^(-2r)<1/4. Direct substitution of Binet formula produces AS=(1-z)(1-z^(2n-1))*sum_{j>=0} z^j/(1-z^(n+j))^2. The lower bound AS>(1-z^(2n-1))(1+2z^n/(1+z))>1 follows since 2(1-z^(2n-1))>z^(n-1)(1+z). The upper gives AS-1<32/9*z^n<S. Thus A-1<1/S<A for integral A>=1. All inequalities and n=r=1 endpoint checked; 256 finite exact rational certificates replayed.
